title: Mobile Consumer Pilot Validation

real_gap_found_and_fixed.description: unlike the collector app's login() which explicitly checks profile.role == COLLECTOR and rejects otherwise, the consumer app's login() had no equivalent check — any role's account could log in successfully
real_gap_found_and_fixed.discovered_by: direct comparison against the collector app's own established, correct pattern while auditing checklist item 'Consumer role'
real_gap_found_and_fixed.fix: added ConsumerProfile.isConsumer getter, AuthRepository.login() now rejects non-CONSUMER accounts client-side before persisting any token, mirroring the collector app's exact message pattern
real_gap_found_and_fixed.register_unaffected: POST /auth/register always creates a CONSUMER account server-side, no wrong-role case exists there

new_tests.note: previously no repository-level auth test existed in this app at all
